moves.Dark Hole: 40% chance to put the target to sleep.
moves.Diamond Storm: Special Rock attack. 50% chance to raise the user's Defense by 2 stages.
moves.Draco Barrage: Hits Fairy types. Uses the better of Attack or Sp. Atk. The user takes 33% of the damage dealt as recoil.
moves.Flash: Special Electric attack with 60 power. 50% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.Muddy Water: 40% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
moves.Ruination: Deals damage equal to half the target's current HP.
moves.Shell Side Arm: Uses the higher of Attack or Sp. Atk. 10% chance to poison the target.
moves.Supercell Slam: If it misses, the user takes 50% of its max HP as crash damage.
moves.Tera Blast: Becomes the user's Tera type when Terastallized, and uses the higher of Attack or Sp. Atk. Stellar Tera: lowers the user's Attack and Sp. Atk by 2 stages.
